name: Button
summary: The main action control, in six variants and three sizes, on a button, a link or a submit input.
description: Use one primary button per view for the action you most want people to take, secondary for the rest, and ghost for quiet actions in toolbars and footers. A link that looks like a button is still a link: it navigates, it does not act.

classes.name: v-btn
classes.description: The button. On its own it is the default, neutral style.

classes.name: v-btn-primary
classes.description: The main action: filled with the accent.

classes.name: v-btn-secondary
classes.description: Bordered, for actions next to a primary one.

classes.name: v-btn-ghost
classes.description: No fill or border until hovered; for toolbars and quiet actions.

classes.name: v-btn-danger
classes.description: Destructive actions. Name the action (Delete project), not just OK.

classes.name: v-btn-block
classes.description: Fills the width of its container.

states.description: Native disabled: dimmed, not focusable, no click.
Looks disabled but stays focusable, for links or when the reason should still be reachable.
Loading: a spinner appears before the label. Pair it with disabled so it is not pressed twice.

keyboard.action: Presses a button. A link button follows its link on Enter only.

a11y: Use <button type="button"> for actions and <a href> for navigation, so the role and keys match what people expect.
A busy button keeps its label in the markup, so screen readers still hear what is loading.
Every variant holds 4.5:1 text contrast in all four directions and both themes.

examples.title: Variants
examples.html:
<button class="v-btn v-btn-primary" type="button">Primary</button>
<button class="v-btn v-btn-secondary" type="button">Secondary</button>
<button class="v-btn v-btn-ghost" type="button">Ghost</button>
<button class="v-btn v-btn-soft" type="button">Soft</button>
<button class="v-btn v-btn-danger" type="button">Danger</button>
<button class="v-btn" type="button">Default</button>

examples.title: Sizes and icons
examples.description: Icons sit before or after the label and scale with the text.
examples.html:
<button class="v-btn v-btn-primary v-btn-sm" type="button"><svg class="v-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="/icons/sprite.svg#plus"/></svg>Small</button>
<button class="v-btn v-btn-primary" type="button">Medium</button>
<button class="v-btn v-btn-primary v-btn-lg" type="button">Large <svg class="v-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="/icons/sprite.svg#arrow-right"/></svg></button>
